up: List all compounds reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4014283. For each compound, return its ChEMBL ID (molecule_chembl_id), name (pref_name), max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES. Order the results by the compound's ChEMBL ID ascending. Ensure each compound is listed only once.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4014283' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC;
